approved_A_execution.recovery: No quarantine or backup was created; deleted weights and legacy predictions are not directly recoverable.

approved_source_execution.recovery: Upstream binaries require pinned redownload; obsolete intermediates were not backed up. Formal data, fixed mapping/SID, model checkpoints and all trace metadata were retained.

reproducibility.boundary: Same source revision + frozen mapping/SID -> same samples/order/splits; not gzip bytes, old mtimes or reclustered SID identity. Upstream future availability is not guaranteed.

recoverability: No backup made. Deleted experimental weights/predictions are not directly recoverable. Source binaries can be redownloaded from the verified pinned revision; obsolete intermediates are not needed to rebuild formal datasets.
